title: RAW UNREVIEWED: abbreviated function expressions must preserve complete recipe alternatives and ingredient scope
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. A recovered writing channel must distinguish recipe-level alternatives, alternative media and jointly required ingredients across one complete account. Evaluate candidate expansions by the actual permitted preparation sets they express, without assuming frequent short forms mean AND or OR and without silently turning omitted scope into recovered content.

design.production_mechanism: A pharmaceutical compiler shortens frequent grammatical expressions while preserving their scope across lists and clauses. Identical small signs may expand differently in context; the shared carrier must not contain hidden editorial expansion identities.
design.owned_source: research_registry/work_batches/ten_hours_20260915/TROTULA_IV15_V19_SOURCE_PACKET_20260920.md: the complete1544 IV15 alternative and V19 experiment. IV15 has an outer Vel, five ana-governed dry ingredients, an inner white-or-sweet-wine alternative, processing and evening administration. V19 gives a differently scoped ingredient list and administration. The source is an existing content exemplar, not newly asserted to contain the required native abbreviation collisions.
design.finite_content_contrast: Compare A: choose one complete recipe; within IV15 require the listed ingredients and choose one allowed medium. B: choose only one listed ingredient but combine both media. C: perform both recipe alternatives. These produce unequal ingredient obligations and numbers of independent preparation plans even if the same noun inventory appears. A common surface AND/OR permutation cannot be accepted solely because it yields a fluent local clause.
design.content_limits: White and sweet are not assumed disjoint chemical categories or two mandatory vessels. Inclusive OR allows a medium satisfying both descriptions; it does not require two separately added media. The administered dose's dry-versus-finished referent remains uncertain. No exact finished-mixture mass or numeric Voynich value is inferred.
design.writing_constraint: Every proposed expansion and scope marker must arise under the same natural carrier/sign law across full passages. No gold expansions, semantic IDs, list boundaries or connective labels may leak into unknown-channel input. Source clause interpretation is an evaluation layer, not a codebook supplied to the fit. If the source writer emits identical observations for two scope readings, report that equivalence rather than choosing the more attractive recipe.
design.positive_knowledge_used: GDT1160's limited contextual-expansion gain and the preserved word-space hierarchy motivate whole-construction interpretation. Whole-form residuals, source boundaries and directed composition remain mandatory; a list of recovered frequent words is insufficient.
design.conditional_target_use: If a distinct natural-channel result yields concrete alternative complete readings, the existing GDT790 f82r P1/P2 records are an already owned native authoring packet for nested-choice hypotheses. Their two initial value fields are not identified ingredients, and no source-template correspondence is asserted. Profile every nominated exact whole before assigning a connective or content value.
nearest_predecessors: IDEA421/GDT1000 own the fixed Trotula quantity writer, which failed; no change of numerals, serialization or matching rule repairs it.

IDEA732 owns alternative carriers versus simultaneous ingredients; this conditional consumer adds the obligation that alternative complete readings arise through an independently frozen shared writing channel, not separate free gloss tables.
IDEA912 owns choice lifetime across stages; this proposal concerns the content preserved by actual competing abbreviated expansions, not a new lifetime rule.
GDT1164 is not repaired and1160's supervised candidate domains cannot be assumed available in Voynich.
design.likely_failure: There may be no genuinely ambiguous connective expansion in the retained source signs. Grammar may recover words while still leaving scope unresolved. Choosing the source's known interpretation as an optimization reward would create circular apparent success; therefore no such fitting is proposed here.
design.next_step: Use only candidate passage readings returned by a separately selected channel task. Compare whole preparation obligations before promoting any connective reading; retain identical-observation rivals. No new source corpus, decoder or target census.
design.access_and_review: RAW unreviewed. Route/composition topic, bounded abbreviation/connector searches and complete existing Trotula packet read. No new target/source acquisition, implementation, reserve access or contacts.
